description: Land Acquisition - Nuwaraeliya, Nuwaraeliya D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1994/30 of 21.11.2016 by D/S Division, Kuliyapitiya West
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of land parcels (including details of the properties, trees, buildings, and claimants) by the government. The content focuses entirely on land-related matters - describing the land to be acquired, its location, extent, boundaries, and compensation claims process. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters.
